Clinical evidence that any supplement reliably prevents hangovers is limited, though several ingredients are commonly taken before drinking to support hydration, antioxidant defenses, and alcohol metabolism.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1_GoPa0H8RrUqFGSID-BWY1ywOix71405kGpk86nEjjOz9rd5YvWQUXdonBqw3bs1cjAWGCBXxKK45XsusBAY1X90h4yg5Qew8WRkn2_lCJCHQNVOt9b2jvbTFwtOqKqDBHomevtj_NJQtTiUTMMIQHLTnArybaqoJ7YjNQsRU56o5eD_g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1zRTA9FXvASQz_GBcz2XTorUuHg5jrmwWZVZKkFsE7Zz5-Ud7clhCFEm6qiyk5f-p87TnYeIigJWGGWkuoNBPlcrYQYplGXBtP4JRR-yp8HJqACFg2c3Ii4qaOnI2upEAtFGLqUoTrAaefL6UHkGoB-AlovEciCOZVRDNZj342CN8VJ0gJjcxmRR8TwZZJE)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXBioklOi25UIpYIB4BBXlub73H8WyzWG5offu2KGT-TsaRAqT3iDEbyXe_v9yAgZmHMdkgLQUVs6E11HlKxN6aea8weIQwI0O1TPmpWKLOdUNbncYEDjdS3Y5FoblF_nfkydZ-nCFw5TZvXe3c1EwziQJV4C7WGvJ)

### Common Pre-Drinking Ingredients

- **Electrolytes (sodium, potassium, magnesium):** Alcohol increases fluid and electrolyte loss, so replenishing them helps address dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1zRTA9FXvASQz_GBcz2XTorUuHg5jrmwWZVZKkFsE7Zz5-Ud7clhCFEm6qiyk5f-p87TnYeIigJWGGWkuoNBPlcrYQYplGXBtP4JRR-yp8HJqACFg2c3Ii4qaOnI2upEAtFGLqUoTrAaefL6UHkGoB-AlovEciCOZVRDNZj342CN8VJ0gJjcxmRR8TwZZJE)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vbBa617LAuM)
- **N-acetylcysteine (NAC) and glutathione:** Used to support antioxidant levels and liver detoxification pathways.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13rDvZtM-ojXDGDVn2vqdC9XeZYykKt8exVi8nRiw4FCgcCWuc-arhHY47LhaVVus0MeMzhNfl7svUcM7UE1SFykQqONM_Zgs3WBFblNC1QB6XzOi8QPIeg-077acfZPLjq6KUc_X8AmyGrCH_fFOhekOEnZpmUK766l8g)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/vbBa617LAuM)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/m9UVG95itgI)
- **Dihydromyricetin (DHM) and milk thistle:** Frequently included in pre-drinking blends for liver and recovery support, though human clinical proof for hangover prevention remains weak.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXBioklOi25UIpYIB4BBXlub73H8WyzWG5offu2KGT-TsaRAqT3iDEbyXe_v9yAgZmHMdkgLQUVs6E11HlKxN6aea8weIQwI0O1TPmpWKLOdUNbncYEDjdS3Y5FoblF_nfkydZ-nCFw5TZvXe3c1EwziQJV4C7WGvJ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1_GoPa0H8RrUqFGSID-BWY1ywOix71405kGpk86nEjjOz9rd5YvWQUXdonBqw3bs1cjAWGCBXxKK45XsusBAY1X90h4yg5Qew8WRkn2_lCJCHQNVOt9b2jvbTFwtOqKqDBHomevtj_NJQtTiUTMMIQHLTnArybaqoJ7YjNQsRU56o5eD_g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13rDvZtM-ojXDGDVn2vqdC9XeZYykKt8exVi8nRiw4FCgcCWuc-arhHY47LhaVVus0MeMzhNfl7svUcM7UE1SFykQqONM_Zgs3WBFblNC1QB6XzOi8QPIeg-077acfZPLjq6KUc_X8AmyGrCH_fFOhekOEnZpmUK766l8g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXD9Jtg5uflNY4NWtC59wS-QQHFozD2texKYknaulxpdA_c_TnEsllIu4mNBsELRLB_QPJE7E3nsIBT_E49Nfc6oMBP69az87eaeMxJKp8iIiz75i6cxJOGWW-gQ2HntBBfSG_hA)
- **B vitamins:** Alcohol depletes B vitamins and interferes with absorption, though taking them beforehand has not been proven to prevent hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1zRTA9FXvASQz_GBcz2XTorUuHg5jrmwWZVZKkFsE7Zz5-Ud7clhCFEm6qiyk5f-p87TnYeIigJWGGWkuoNBPlcrYQYplGXBtP4JRR-yp8HJqACFg2c3Ii4qaOnI2upEAtFGLqUoTrAaefL6UHkGoB-AlovEciCOZVRDNZj342CN8VJ0gJjcxmRR8TwZZJE)
- **Targeted probiotics:** Products like [ZBiotics](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXJb9xFrIoJJ_OTzds7LJAjTNP9OU3X52uA04c110THawoqvXi0n8Tj-Ztq4vW_klMcW_K6INxU42TxdfzHeYV6Gz1yM-09j8SK-YMMpvc2Ce_ZXbZMyI-ZuOGOGHGoQ) use engineered *Bacillus subtilis* taken before drinking to break down acetaldehyde in the gut, while [Morning Recovery](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESsAEBxCJF16wZ7wa-bX2_hTGMp4ElmjEitYUfa_BYy1y0weUsETeN_8X4natUN688F0mdPU9cl77dBTNLWTMVcTk2YWNN-YqBoSNLXuNKbLXJ1UgdX9E21_siXsliIdWAPZQQCPy33Niwn2fBPRdQ3vC-kJydkZ0h7tzPbkiEc7GnFAbQPsTwvaSyryM5xNR2qsp5KjTKMxsLisvkH5-SR5dr1fQvGJPsPDGtKkrdz52xDw) combines hydration and recovery ingredients for before or during drinking. As covered by [TIME](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1_GoPa0H8RrUqFGSID-BWY1ywOix71405kGpk86nEjjOz9rd5YvWQUXdonBqw3bs1cjAWGCBXxKK45XsusBAY1X90h4yg5Qew8WRkn2_lCJCHQNVOt9b2jvbTFwtOqKqDBHomevtj_NJQtTiUTMMIQHLTnArybaqoJ7YjNQsRU56o5eD_g) , controlled trials show limited overall proof that these products prevent hangovers, and [WIRED](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXBioklOi25UIpYIB4BBXlub73H8WyzWG5offu2KGT-TsaRAqT3iDEbyXe_v9yAgZmHMdkgLQUVs6E11HlKxN6aea8weIQwI0O1TPmpWKLOdUNbncYEDjdS3Y5FoblF_nfkydZ-nCFw5TZvXe3c1EwziQJV4C7WGvJ) notes that hydration, food, and moderation remain primary.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXJb9xFrIoJJ_OTzds7LJAjTNP9OU3X52uA04c110THawoqvXi0n8Tj-Ztq4vW_klMcW_K6INxU42TxdfzHeYV6Gz1yM-09j8SK-YMMpvc2Ce_ZXbZMyI-ZuOGOGHGoQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXl0kBmps-wcMDFSFz1CJWdzrRYfJzRNzFDg2LQa1RgV4gmQ4hMzZIUZfJTI0kYp3mB7v68ax0keyLPa63pnEEFKQnMWJW1ZXIkLukDo6DCf4nb1gKOi6aBjrEkStrsvp698i6DNWBpvTzsw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1_GoPa0H8RrUqFGSID-BWY1ywOix71405kGpk86nEjjOz9rd5YvWQUXdonBqw3bs1cjAWGCBXxKK45XsusBAY1X90h4yg5Qew8WRkn2_lCJCHQNVOt9b2jvbTFwtOqKqDBHomevtj_NJQtTiUTMMIQHLTnArybaqoJ7YjNQsRU56o5eD_g)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXBioklOi25UIpYIB4BBXlub73H8WyzWG5offu2KGT-TsaRAqT3iDEbyXe_v9yAgZmHMdkgLQUVs6E11HlKxN6aea8weIQwI0O1TPmpWKLOdUNbncYEDjdS3Y5FoblF_nfkydZ-nCFw5TZvXe3c1EwziQJV4C7WGvJ)

### Safety Notes

- **Avoid acetaminophen:** Do not take acetaminophen before or while drinking due to liver stress and toxicity risk.
- **Food and pacing matter most:** Eating a balanced meal beforehand and pacing drinks slow alcohol absorption more reliably than pills.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF1_GoPa0H8RrUqFGSID-BWY1ywOix71405kGpk86nEjjOz9rd5YvWQUXdonBqw3bs1cjAWGCBXxKK45XsusBAY1X90h4yg5Qew8WRkn2_lCJCHQNVOt9b2jvbTFwtOqKqDBHomevtj_NJQtTiUTMMIQHLTnArybaqoJ7YjNQsRU56o5eD_g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13rDvZtM-ojXDGDVn2vqdC9XeZYykKt8exVi8nRiw4FCgcCWuc-arhHY47LhaVVus0MeMzhNfl7svUcM7UE1SFykQqONM_Zgs3WBFblNC1QB6XzOi8QPIeg-077acfZPLjq6KUc_X8AmyGrCH_fFOhekOEnZpmUK766l8g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1zRTA9FXvASQz_GBcz2XTorUuHg5jrmwWZVZKkFsE7Zz5-Ud7clhCFEm6qiyk5f-p87TnYeIigJWGGWkuoNBPlcrYQYplGXBtP4JRR-yp8HJqACFg2c3Ii4qaOnI2upEAtFGLqUoTrAaefL6UHkGoB-AlovEciCOZVRDNZj342CN8VJ0gJjcxmRR8TwZZJE)

N-acetylcysteine (NAC) and glutathione: Used to support antioxidant levels and liver detoxification pathways. B vitamins: Alcohol depletes B vitamins and interferes with absorption, though taking them beforehand has not been proven to prevent hangovers.
